scenario: Empty workspace OpenCode model-catalogue request; cold startup followed by immediate warm request; no message or model inference.

method.coldRequest: GET /api/onboarding/opencode/models from a confirmed stopped runtime
method.warmRequest: Immediate repeat of the same request after ready/image-backed runtime proof
method.resetRequest: POST /api/onboarding/reset; each reset returned 200 and debug confirmed stopped
method.priming: One untimed image/runtime start and reset per profile before three measured samples
checks: container was stopped before each cold sample
runtime was ready and image-backed after each cold sample
no session, budget reservation or queued work was created
each profile used the same digest-pinned image and empty workspace

decision: Keep custom-1cpu-2gib as the default. These three public-network, no-inference samples show no material cold/warm advantage for standard-2; they do not establish turn throughput, p95, memory headroom, or cost per accepted task.
limits: Three samples per profile; no p95 claim.
Empty workspace and model-catalogue request, not first-token or model-turn latency.
Public network latency and model-list response time are included.
No representative repository, memory/RSS, OOM or active-hour cost measurement.
